data.title: Fighting About AI At Thanksgiving Is the ‘Latest Generational Beef’
data.description: This Thanksgiving, it’s probably best to leave AI conversations off the table. Over the past decade, the US’s chaotic, increasingly polarized political climate has put American families to the test. With AI now entering the mix, psychologist Matt Lundquist calls it the “It's the latest generational beef.” He’s found that arguments over AI are on the rise—especially among families.
data.author: Condé Nast
